Lovely vegetarian experience!
Aug 2026 • Family
Had such a lovely meal at Achi. I’ve tried quite a few vegetarian restaurants before, but this one really stood out to me.
The food was made with lots of fresh ingredients, and I really liked how they combined different flavours and textures. Everything tasted light but still very interesting. You can honestly feel how much effort and passion the chef puts into each dish.
Definetely a place I’d come back to when I’m in the area. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a nice, relaxing vegetarian meal!

Hidden Gem?
Apr 2018 • Couples
We really enjoyed our food here, especially the tofu stew and the fried glass noodles, which came with a plentiful supply of delicious mushrooms—not your garden variety but a really special sort I couldn’t identify. 

The staff are very friendly and the ambience is cheerful, if a little lacking in decor. The menu is in English as well as Vietnamese but the English explanations, unfortunately, often don’t help too much and there are no photos to help. Everything we had was first rate and fresh, though, and delicately prepared. Portions seemed a little small at first but we didn’t go away hungry. Rather, we left feeling we had had a delicious, healthy meal served by pleasant people who take pride in what they prepare.

Vegan or not, Here we Come!
Mar 2018 • Couples
We had vermicelli with mushrooms, fried spring rolls and a delectable Szechuan tofu stew. All were extremely delicious, the service was quick and friendly, and the environment clean and comfortable, with very bright natural
Light and several seats looking out over the street from the second floor. 

Perhaps a little hard to spot from the street—easier from the west side of the street (across the street from the restaurant, away from the lake). Also, the front may look empty and closed from the street as most of the activity takes place upstairs. Try the door and see. 

Highly recommended!

A treat for Vegan
Dec 2017 • Couples
If you are looking for a vegetarian Vietnamese delight during your trip to Hanoi, ensure not to miss Achi Vegan House. From their customer service to the food they serve, you will be delighted on how well you are treated. The place is very well maintained. The staff are friendly and they can be able to converse in English well. 
Their noodles are wonderful. Being a non vegetarian myself, I really enjoyed their vegetarian food. A must try eatery in Hanoi even if you are a non vegetarian.
They have a good menu that you can choose from and do ask for more information from their friendly staff if you looking to try their must try dishes
